meta.name: Climate Crisis Resilience Fee (Τέλος Ανθεκτικότητας στην Κλιματική Κρίση — ΤΑΚ)
meta.basis: Per night, per room or apartment unit
meta.collection: Collected from the guest by the accommodation provider, documented on a special receipt
meta.declaration_deadline: Last day of the month following the month the receipt was issued
meta.disclaimer: Compiled from public secondary sources in August 2026. Verify against AADE before billing guests or filing declarations. Rates increased in January 2025 and are reported unchanged for 2026, but this is exactly the kind of figure that moves with each budget.

product_note: Hotel rates are included for reference only. Hotels are explicitly out of scope for the MVP (see docs/03-product-spec.md) — different law, different buyer, different sales motion.
